interpretation_limits: 437 archived *packages* are not 437 species, independently sampled populations or empirically usable repeated individual tracks.
DOIs can represent source subset/versions or multiple taxa; source `-reference-data.csv` and movement `GPS`/ACCELEROMETER labels must be checked for deployment overlap and animal-IDs.
License differences and individual-tag sensitivity require per-package authorization/credit checks. This catalogue stores only published metadata and no animal GPS positions or identifiers.

Eligibility for the planned cross-taxon individual-identity and ecological co-use estimands has NOT yet been established from raw track lengths, repeated deployments, within-population overlap, environmental states or vertical datum.
Taxonomic classes cannot be reliably inferred from general textual subject keywords without authoritative taxon reference records.
